method: Three physical coordinate concepts evaluated with unchanged footprint courtyards/pad numbering. Euclidean MST excludes GND and isolated NCs; crossing count is a layout congestion proxy, not actual routed crossings or actual KiCad ratsnest topology.

alternatives.name: A_Compact
alternatives.DSI_via_planning: Concept estimate: 4-12 DSI vias; reduced tuning/escape width and tight connector service gaps.

alternatives.name: B_Routing_SI
alternatives.DSI_via_planning: Plan 4-12 DSI vias depending on connector side escapes/lane crossover; no vias placed. Up to two per conductor retained.

alternatives.name: C_Mechanical
alternatives.DSI_via_planning: Longer opposing-edge channel; 4-12 DSI vias may still be required. Mechanical concept, not completed routing.

refinement: J1 moved 2.5 mm toward J2; TE resistor and bulk TP bypass moved to preserve access and reduce signal span; boost kernel refined separately.
